Package io.jengacode.eduvideo.render

Class BackgroundRenderer

java.lang.Object
io.jengacode.eduvideo.render.BackgroundRenderer
public final class BackgroundRenderer extends Object
Configurable, deterministic procedural backdrop; decoded images are optional and never required.

Combines a linear base, radial illumination, optional image, perspective grid, curves, fixed dots and vignette. Patterns are deterministic and screen-fixed. Images decode during configuration rather than once per frame.

    • options

      public BackgroundRenderer options(boolean grid, boolean curves, boolean dots, boolean vignette, double intensity)
      Configures deterministic backdrop layers and clamped effect intensity.
      Parameters:
      grid - whether grid lines are enabled
      curves - whether abstract background curves are enabled
      dots - whether the fixed dot pattern is enabled
      vignette - whether to darken the background edges
      intensity - effect strength, clamped to [0,1]
      Returns:
      this instance for fluent configuration
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if an input violates the constraints described above
